title: Ultrasound - based deep learning radiomics nomogram for noninvasive prediction of p53 mutation status in hepatocellular carcinoma: a variational autoencoder based development and validation study.
summary: VAE-derived ultrasound image features were combined with clinical variables to predict p53 IHC status in pathologically confirmed HCC; among 172 patients (120 training, 52 validation), the validation AUC was 0.820. The validation cohort is small and retrospective.
